caption: Real humanoid: HOIST guides the load to its target.
description: A real humanoid running HOIST faces a gray box hanging from straps above a wooden platform with an outlined target. The robot reaches toward the box and adjusts hand contact as the load descends, and the box reaches the platform. This is the HOIST panel of the real-platform segment of the authors’ comparison, at original speed and without audio; black gutters and title bands are removed while the robot, load, and target are retained.

caption: Simulation: HOIST guides the load onto its landing platform.
description: The final phase of a HOIST simulation. A cable-suspended box descends toward a rectangular platform as the humanoid adjusts hand contact and stance, and the box settles into its final position and orientation. Black gutters and title bands are removed; the robot, load, and target are retained at original speed without audio.
